_about: The least flash and RAM, in bytes, each image of a firmware build must keep free; tools/memory_budget.py checks them in every firmware job (docs/ci.md, 'Memory headroom'). Keyed by the firmware job's matrix configuration, then by image: app, mcuboot, tfm, or the network core's build folder. Each floor starts just below what the build had when it was set. Lower one only in the pull request that needs it, and say why there.

default._measured: 1.18.0, main e29e53a: app 45298 flash / 1100 RAM free, mcuboot 15212 flash, tfm 552 flash / 12532 RAM. 1.19.1 (offline Bluetooth mode, #127): app 40810 flash / 1004 RAM free; the app's flash floor was lowered from 40960 to 40448 for it, as offline mode's GATT service and its console command take about 4.5 KB of flash. 1.19.3 (golden image promotion, #216): app 38218 flash / 932 RAM free, mcuboot 12484 flash; the app's floors were lowered to 37888 flash and 900 RAM, and MCUboot's to 12288, for the promotion's job and report in the application (2.6 KB, 72 bytes of RAM, the record sharing the job's URL buffer) and the record's check, the state page and the golden key in the bootloader (2.7 KB). MCUboot's code must also end below 0xf000, where its state page is: its build checks that. 1.19.3 with the Pi message link (#58): app 33210 flash / 1860 RAM free; the app's flash floor was lowered to 32768 for it, as the link takes about 4.9 KB of flash, about 2 KB of it the SPI peripheral (SPIS) driver it needs

no Bluetooth._measured: 1.18.0, first run of this check (#189): app 128410 flash / 36104 RAM free, mcuboot 15212 flash, tfm 552 flash / 12532 RAM. MCUboot's floor lowered to 12288 in 1.19.3 as for default, the same bootloader

nRF5340 DK._measured: 1.18.0, main e29e53a: app 598114 flash / 302552 RAM free, mcuboot 22016 flash, tfm 49708 flash / 19316 RAM

Pi delta updates._measured: 1.20.0, Raspberry Pi delta updates on the Pi message link (#58), local build (scripts/firmware/build.sh --pi --keep --no-upload --without-key): app 98370 flash / 18880 RAM free with the card in the heartbeat (98442 / 18944 before it: 392 bytes of flash for it, 320 trimmed back from the SD stack's info-level notes and two of the update's log lines, and 64 bytes of RAM for the larger shadow document), mcuboot 12484 flash, tfm 552 flash / 12532 RAM. No Bluetooth; the update's thread (5 KiB of stack for TLS), the link's own work queue (2 KiB), the frames, the URL and the card's buffers take about 17 KiB of what the no-Bluetooth build leaves. The app's RAM floor was 19456 when the delta updates had a link of their own (#276, 19808 free): sharing #58's link adds its kept np and hb and a larger queue stack, which also prints the Pi's messages
